body.p: Earlier there were three worlds. Up there was God, down there was his elder brother, Satan. In the middle world God was working, Satan was working, too. God made a duck, Satan made, like he, also a loon. God made a swan, Satan made a black woodpecker; God made a wolverine, Satan made a bear; God made a fox, Satan made a wolf. Gott gave names to all of them. He prohibited the people to eat all those who were made by Satan. Then God made the man and the woman. His helper was a raven. The raven guarded what [God] had created. God asked him: "What are they doing?" "They are living, they give birth to children, it has become many people. They are hunting, they kill foxes and wolverines", the raven said. Satan came to the raven, he asked: "Let me have a look at his creation, I'll give you good food, I'll give you the stomach contents." The raven let him [have a look]. Having eaten, it said: "Tasty". Then God asked: "How are the people living?" The raven said: "I gave them to Satan, for that he [can] look at them". God got angry with the raven, he forced it to eat carrion and excrements.
